node.statement: By def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra, the conclusion of node 1.2.1 means that every M_n tensor S_P is a (C_ca*e)-C*-algebra with the amplified compressed product and inherited involution. Its registered lower C*-axiom, applied to Z, is exactly ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-C_ca*e)||Z||^2, uniformly in n.
